in_marathi.name: Pappya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pappya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Marathi word 'pappa', meaning 'father'. In Hindu mythology, Pappya is a term of endearment for the deity Ganesha, who is often referred to as the protector and remover of obstacles.
